## Goal
- User (owner of the repo) is developing a custom compaction feature and first asked for an overview of it (answered), then redirected: **review the last few commits individually and explain what each does/Adds**.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Per-commit review requested over a high-level overview ("rather check last few commits individually").
- Repo rules apply: no Prettier mid-task, tests make no provider calls, `npm run test:run` + `npx tsc --noEmit` for validation.

## Progress
### Done
- [x] Overview delivered: feature is custom two-stage compaction replacing pi core compaction via `session_before_compact` handler in `src/modules/compaction/index.ts` (stage 1 "native" = shorter cached-prefix rebuild → `<segment-checkpoint>`; stage 2 "reduce" = bounded serialized call; fallback to core default, never throws). Installed for parent and all delegated children.
- [x] Gathered `git log -10 --stat` for the 10 newest commits on branch `wip/better-compaction`.
- [x] Reviewed diff of `5cef321` (more traces) and `e8bad4a` (tmp: tracing system) via `git show`.

### In Progress
- [ ] Per-commit explanation of the last 10 commits, oldest→newest. Remaining to inspect (git show): `a5db400` (trace logging improvements), `d53da2a` (system prompt hash check), `e066bbc` (log traces for hash chains), `fd64ad9` (use bundle for script), `9b670b7` (drop tool_choice arg), `7ac6be8` (add missing thinking level), `aacf020` (add missing sampling params), `8ab0be2` (improvements on compaction tracing).

### Blocked
- (none)

## Key Decisions
- **Review order oldest→newest** (5cef321 → 8ab0be2) so the narrative flows; use `git show <hash> -- <paths>` filtered to `src/`/`scripts/` to skip memory-file noise.

## Next Steps
1. `git show` the 8 remaining commits (list above), oldest→newest, filtering to source/test paths.
2. Write up the per-commit summary for the user (what each commit adds, key files/symbols).
3. Offer follow-ups: branch hygiene (28 `wip:` commits to squash, `git-rebase-helper` skill) or continuing open threads.

## Critical Context
- Branch `wip/better-compaction`: 28 commits ahead of main, 64 files changed, +13,727/−125; working tree clean. Commits dated 2026-09-05/06 by "itterative".
- **5cef321 (more traces)** — `scripts/compaction-report.mjs` + `src/modules/compaction/index.ts`: added the prefix funnel (`chainObservations`/`branchObservations`/`observations`) and `unknowns[]` to the report; `invariantViolations()` with 5 cross-field checks (chain-empty-contradiction, none-with-branch, comparable-without-branch, usable-without-depth, hash-length-conflict) + new INVARIANTS section; suspects `chain-empty`/`chain-off-branch`/`chain-incomparable`/`system-prompt-drift`; `chain=held/branch/comparable` and `sys=`/`parent-sys=` bits on the prefix line; `~ cannot tell:` lines. `index.ts: prefixVerdict` now computes `onBranch` via `chain.branchObservations(pathIds)` and mirrors the newest on-branch entry as `parentRequest`.
- **e8bad4a (tmp: tracing system)** — docs-only: new `docs/state-tracing-system.md` (202 lines), status "Planned and deliberately deferred". Design for a shared state-tracing system: 4 stores (`.state/compaction-trace.jsonl`, `.state/bash-log.jsonl`, `.state/meta.sqlite`, session `custom` entries); record envelope `{v, ts, producer, kind, run, session, cwd, instance, payload}`; retention classes `state`/`metric`/`body`/`pinned`; non-goals (not an event bus, not a metrics pipeline). Notes 85.3% of trace bytes are model/summary bodies.
- Stats for remaining commits (from --stat, not yet diffed):
  - `a5db400`: renames `scripts/*.mjs` → `*.ts` (compaction-report.ts, permission-report.ts); new `src/common/record-log.ts` (283 lines, shared rotation); refactors `src/modules/sandbox/decision-log.ts`, `trace.ts`, compaction `config.ts`; new `test/common/record-log.test.ts`; package.json scripts.
  - `d53da2a`: tiny — `chain.ts` +3/−1, system prompt hashed whole instead of 320-char excerpt.
  - `e066bbc` (biggest, +1,419): new `src/modules/compaction/chain-store.ts` (389 lines, persisted `chain_request`/`chain_ladder` rows + hydration); `src/common/trace.ts` +12 (`PROCESS_INSTANCE`/`isAgentTraceEnabled`); `config.ts` +`chainTraceEnabled`; `chain.ts`, `index.ts`, `compaction-report.ts`; docs (state-tracing-system.md, bash-decision-log.md, compaction-trace-report.md); `test/setup.ts`; new `chain-store.test.ts` (258 lines).
  - `fd64ad9`: new `test/helpers/script-bundle.ts` (+64), compaction-report.test.ts switched to it; test-doubles memory note.
  - `9b670b7`: drops `toolChoice: "none"` from stage-1 request (summarize.ts, prompt.ts, index.ts, chain.ts, trace.ts) + test/doc updates.
  - `7ac6be8`: stage 1 forwards thinking level — `summarize.ts: turnThinkingEffort` (+43), `index.ts` reads `pi.getThinkingLevel()` in try/catch, `types.ts`, `test/helpers/pi-stub.ts` +17.
  - `aacf020`: `summarize.ts: callForSummary` merges `model.samplingParams` (+13) on both stages; handler test.
  - `8ab0be2` (newest): chain.ts +265/−~110 (one-reference verdict: `compareLadder`/`compareObservation`, `disagreeingReferences`), `chain-store.ts` +32, `index.ts` +90, `prefix-diff.ts` +88 (value-level scalar divergences: maxTokens/enableThinking/reasoningEffort/imageBlocks), `trace.ts`, `compaction-report.ts` +99, docs, tests (chain, chain-store, prefix-diff, trace, report).
- Full background lives in project memory `.pi/agent/memory/compaction.md` (high-churn, read this session) plus `compaction-chain-blindness.md`.
- Open threads (from overview reply): `model` config field accepted-but-unused = seam for dedicated compaction model; decode-scalar recording follow-up (group with `cutFound`); gap 4 (children have no UI) and gap 5 (silent-overflow providers) still open; 28 `wip:` commits need squashing before merge.

</checkpoint>
